note: A curated selection, not the whole surface. Add an entry here and it appears in the explorer.

groups.name: Node — Fastlane
groups.blurb: What a node's Asterisk will do, asked over HTTP. This is how an agent's hold, transfer or hangup reaches the machine their phone is registered on.

endpoints.summary: Whether this node's Fastlane is up.
Run one agent action on this node.
endpoints.detail: One endpoint for every action, because that is what the action set is: a name and the fields it needs. Always answers 200 with the result inside — "the agent is not on this node" and "Asterisk refused it" are answers, not transport failures.

groups.name: Node — Host agent
groups.blurb: The machine itself: its units, its network plan, its clock. This is the only service that acts on the box rather than on a call.

endpoints.summary: Whether the host agent is up on this node.
Every Xema unit on this machine and what it is doing.
Start, stop or restart one unit.
endpoints.detail: Xema's own units only. Infrastructure — the database, the broker, Redis, Asterisk — is never started or stopped here, because moving one moves data with it.

groups.name: Metrics
groups.blurb: What the floor did, live and historic. The dashboards read these; so can you.

endpoints.summary: Every queue's current state — waiting, longest wait, agents ready.
Answered, abandoned and service level per day.
One agent's day — handled, talk time, wrap, breaks.
endpoints.detail: Authenticated, unlike the rest of this service: it names a person rather than a floor-wide total.

groups.name: Queue engine
groups.blurb: The queues themselves, on the node running them. Bound to loopback: which queues run and who is in them is decided by the site, not asked for from outside.

endpoints.summary: Engine liveness and what it is running.
Every queue this node is running, with its callers and members.
Who is waiting in one queue, across the whole site.

endpoints.detail: One call, and it states the answer rather than describing a change — there is nothing to miss and no ordering to get right. Add, remove and pause used to sit beside it and are gone.
